title: ライバル登場、その名は……

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Special Week does great at the Japanese Derby, but her battle has only just begun.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's in the company of many tough rivals, such as El Condor Pasa and Grass Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky approaches Special Week with a mysterious air and challenges her to battle at the Kikuka Sho and spring Tenno Sho.
